name: Arthur Fist
look: A close-up cartoon frame of Arthur's tan hand clenched into a tight fist, poking out of the ribbed cuff of his yellow sweater against his blue jeans. A pinkish-red house with a window shows in the background.
use: Expresses quiet, bottled-up rage. The caption describes an infuriating moment where you can't react, like a slow walker blocking the hallway or someone spoiling a show, and the clenched fist shows the anger.
examples: When someone tells me to calm down while I'm completely calm
When the group chat plans everything while I'm in the shower
describe: cartoon aardvark hand clenched into a tight fist
close up of a kid in a yellow sweater squeezing his fist in anger
angry cartoon fist holding in rage
hand balled up into a fist holding back anger
origin: A frame from the PBS cartoon Arthur showing the title character clenching his fist.
